items.brief: 发布450万对工具调用偏好数据集及与数据来源无关的生成器，用于训练企业智能体调用API。
items.why: 企业智能体落地依赖工具调用能力，可作为选型与自建参考。

items.title: ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
items.summary: arXiv:2611.26782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery. Yet an MD study requires an expert-driven workflow: designing the simulation, writing reliable input scripts, executing them, and analyzing the results with separate tools. items.zh: ChatAtom：分子动力学模拟与可视化的多智能体系统
items.brief: 论文提出多智能体大模型系统，自动完成分子动力学模拟与可视化流程。

items.title: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
items.summary: arXiv:2611.26906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) theorem solvers differ in both proving capability and inference cost. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. We present BudgetPV, an agentic budget-aware predict-and-verify system that allocates computation across unresolved subgoals and heterogeneous LLM solvers. items.zh: 预算感知的异构LLM定理证明与验证
items.brief: 论文提出按推理成本调度不同LLM求解器进行定理证明的预算感知方法。

items.title: AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress
items.summary: arXiv:2611.26910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents are expected to improve themselves from their own experience across episodes, with fixed weights. Self-improvement in an embodied world cannot be read from one measure. Existing benchmarks measure task progress, world-knowledge question answering (QA), and episodic memory, but a correct answer does not show that the agent ever observed the evidence for it, and progress does not show what the agent learned. items.zh: AstronautBench：跨回合衡量智能体自我改进
items.brief: 发布基准，从知识、证据与进展三方面衡量LLM智能体跨回合的自我改进能力。

items.title: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
items.summary: arXiv:2611.26912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing complexity of electronic systems demands efficient design flows, yet EDA scripting remains a bottleneck: proprietary APIs are sparsely documented, and errors often appear as silent failures or cryptic exceptions. Hand-crafted knowledge helps but is difficult to maintain as toolchains evolve. We present ZhuLong-SE (Self-Evolution), an execution-grounded LLM agent that learns reusable knowledge from prior task traces. items.zh: 面向EDA脚本的自演化经验学习
items.brief: 论文提出让智能体在EDA脚本编写中自我演化经验，减少对人工知识的依赖。

items.title: Self-similar Organization of Information in Language
items.summary: arXiv:2611.26935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How much information relevant to predicting the future of a passage (i.e. predictive information) is carried by the preceding text, and how is this information distributed along that history? These questions are fundamental to understanding both the statistical structure of language and what large language models (LLMs) can learn about it. Indeed, LLMs trained to predict the next token in text must exploit this predictive information, so its organization determines how the structure of language becomes available to the model to learn. items.zh: 语言中信息的自相似组织方式
items.brief: 论文研究预测性信息在文本历史中的分布规律，发现其呈自相似组织。

items.title: How to build and maintain an agentic evaluation
items.zh: 如何构建与维护智能体评估体系
items.brief: Hugging Face发布教程，讲解如何构建和维护智能体（agentic）评估。
items.why: 智能体上线需评估机制，可作企业AI项目治理参考。

items.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
items.summary: AWS Quick now has a Meta ads AI connector. Meta advertisers can use natural language in Quick to create, manage, and analyze campaigns while staying connected to the Meta ad management network, and combine Meta ad data with first- and third-party sources to build dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows.
items.zh: Meta广告AI连接器上线AWS Quick
items.brief: AWS Quick新增Meta广告AI连接器，广告主可用自然语言创建、管理、分析广告活动，并整合多方数据生成看板与文档。
items.why: 广告投放可用自然语言操作，中小企业营销团队效率与门槛将变化。

items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.summary: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.
items.zh: Perplexity与智能：AI模型进展的衡量
items.brief: OpenAI发文介绍perplexity如何衡量AI模型进展，以及为何有助于开发者建立评估新兴能力的共同方法。

items.title: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
items.summary: AWS Quick is the AI workspace built only for work. Today we're releasing updates that help your team get more done: build and run business-process flows in chat, triage your day in the updated web app, get more complete answers from multiple agents at once, and connect new data sources like Meta ads and Amplitude.
items.zh: AWS Quick 更新：流程、网页体验与多智能体协作
items.brief: AWS Quick 发布更新，支持在聊天中构建业务流程、新版网页应用、多智能体协同回答及接入 Meta 广告等数据源。
items.why: 展示 AI 工作台如何嵌入业务流程，可作为企业办公自动化的参考案例。

items.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill
items.summary: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS, which evaluates and sets up the cache from your coding agent.
items.zh: 分布式 KV 缓存降低自托管大模型成本与延迟
items.brief: AWS 介绍用 ElastiCache 做分布式 KV 缓存，可将推理成本降最多 40%、首字延迟降最多 80%。
items.why: 自建大模型的企业可据此评估降本空间，但偏技术实施细节。

items.title: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, bringing declarative, API- and console-driven configuration to the software running on Slurm cluster nodes. This post explains how the extensions work and follows a platform team through a quarter of running a shared Slurm cluster with them.
items.zh: SageMaker HyperPod Slurm 推出托管集群扩展
items.brief: HyperPod 为 Slurm 集群节点提供可观测性与用户管理的托管扩展，支持 API 和控制台声明式配置。

items.title: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod introduces the Global Inference Gateway, one managed endpoint that routes inference requests across your HyperPod clusters in one Region or across Regions. It picks the best cluster, fails over automatically, and authenticates every request with SigV4 and IAM over AWS PrivateLink.
items.zh: HyperPod 推出跨区域全局推理网关
items.brief: HyperPod 发布 Global Inference Gateway，单一端点跨区域和集群路由推理请求，自动故障转移并用 IAM 鉴权。
items.why: 多集群部署大模型的企业可关注其高可用与统一接入能力。

items.title: How Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessment for generative AI
items.summary: Standard Bank Group automated the evidence behind its generative AI approval gates. Working with AWS Professional Services, the bank built an assessment in its own AWS account that scores each use case against international AI standards and its own policies using LLM-as-a-judge on Amazon Bedrock, giving risk committees consistent, traceable evidence.
items.zh: 标准银行用大模型自动化生成式 AI 风险评估
items.brief: 标准银行与 AWS 合作，在自有账户内用 Bedrock 的 LLM 评审自动为生成式 AI 用例打分，对照国际标准与内部政策。
items.why: AI 合规审批自动化的真实案例，适合讲给关注治理的老板。

items.title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
items.summary: Announcing the general availability of Amazon Textract Insights, a new generative AI feature of Amazon Textract. Describe the fields you need in natural language, submit a document or a mixed packet, and receive structured results with a confidence score and page-level grounding for each value, with no model training required.
items.zh: 亚马逊Textract推出可验证生成式AI文档解析
items.brief: Amazon Textract Insights正式可用，用户用自然语言描述所需字段，提交文档或混合包后返回带置信度和页码定位的结构化结果。
items.why: 票据、合同、表单等文档自动化提取有了可验证的生成式AI方案，适合评估财务与行政流程降本。

items.title: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers enhanced observability to help you diagnose GPU training issues faster. It brings together diagnostic and profiling capabilities for training workloads on both Amazon EKS and Slurm orchestrators, pinpointing issues across GPU, network, and host layers.
items.zh: SageMaker HyperPod增强基础设施可观测性
items.brief: SageMaker HyperPod新增可观测性能力，聚合诊断与性能分析，定位GPU、网络、主机层训练问题。

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
items.zh: OpenAI介绍对抗性蒸馏的防护做法
items.brief: OpenAI发文说明其对抗性蒸馏的分层防护思路，结合模型训练、安全措施、检测与执法来防止能力被提取。
items.why: 提示企业使用第三方模型或自研模型时需关注模型能力被窃取与合规风险。

items.title: Where the Tokens Go: Heat, Entropy and Error in Agentic Coding
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. items.title: HardwareDx: A Foundational Graph Model System for Datacenter Machine Repairs
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. items.title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. items.zh: 人机协同生成与校验数学测评题

items.title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. items.title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Navigation Behavior of Vision-Language Model Agents Reading Emergency CT and MRI Examinations
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Purpose. To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy and image navigation behavior of vision-language model (VLM) agents under varying exploration strategies. Materials and Methods. items.title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. items.zh: SpecLook加速多模态智能体图像检索推理
items.brief: arXiv论文提出SpecLook，推测智能体应在何处放大查看图像，以加快推理并给出可靠性评分。

items.title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. items.zh: GRAFT用执行引导的基因重组设计智能体
items.brief: arXiv论文提出GRAFT，通过执行引导的遗传重组自动搜索更优的LLM智能体架构。

items.title: BeFit: Shifting Complexity from Weights to Bernstein Activations for Resource-Constrained Sensing
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-series sensing increasingly relies on neural networks, yet deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers remains challenging. Aggressive model compression can reduce accuracy, while restricting weights to multiplication-free representations introduces further losses. We present BeFit, an end-to-end framework that shifts model capacity from weights to learnable Bernstein polynomial activations. items.zh: BeFit用Bernstein激活降低边缘设备算力需求

items.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2

items.title: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock

items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?

items.zh: OpenAI发布MedChemBench评估AI药物发现能力
items.brief: OpenAI介绍MedChemBench基准，评估AI模型解读分子结构、依据实验证据推理并筛选早期药物候选化合物的能力。

items.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
items.summary: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.

items.zh: Hugging Face发布Inkling 2 Mini模型

items.why: 偏开发者工程细节，对老板决策关联弱，可作技术趋势参考。

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.why: 新模型在专业场景的能力信号，可作选型参考。

items.title: Enable AI agents to pay for AWS Marketplace x402 products with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments now supports AWS Marketplace, so agents can discover and buy x402-enabled products, APIs, data, and content and pay in USD on the developer's AWS bill, with no stablecoin wallets or API keys. This post walks through a research agent that finds a tool, pays per request through AWS Billing, and answers with sources.
items.zh: AgentCore支付支持AWS Marketplace采购
items.brief: Bedrock AgentCore payments支持Marketplace，智能体可按次付费购买x402产品并计入AWS账单。

items.title: How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers
items.summary: When hundreds of agents serve thousands of developers, governance cannot be an afterthought. The BMW Group shares the practices and patterns its R&D teams use to build, govern, and operate AI agents at enterprise scale without sacrificing speed, quality, or compliance.
items.zh: 宝马如何治理数千开发者数百智能体
items.brief: 宝马集团分享研发团队在规模化下构建、治理和运营AI智能体的实践与模式。
items.why: 大型企业智能体治理范本，可作中小企业AI治理培训的标杆案例。

items.title: Run your whole selling business in AWS Quick
items.summary: Most sellers do not need another AI product to learn. They need the tools and information they already use brought together, so they can see what is happening in their business and act on it.
items.zh: 在AWS Quick中经营整个销售业务
items.brief: AWS介绍Quick产品，将卖家现有工具和信息整合以查看并处理业务。

items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors your generative AI inference endpoints by default and tells you when a change could improve performance or lower cost. It tracks latency, GPU utilization, and serving configuration, then sends a finding through AWS Health with a one-click path to benchmark alternatives in SageMaker Studio before you apply any change.
items.zh: SageMaker默认监测推理端点延迟漂移

items.why: 推理成本与性能可自动发现，企业AI运维降本有了现成抓手。

Structured behavioral interviews offer a research-backed approach to this challenge. They use consistent, job-related questions and clear scoring criteria […]
items.zh: Amazon Connect Talent结构化AI面试

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness adds Strands harness defaults, built-in tools, and lifecycle hooks

items.zh: Bedrock AgentCore harness 新增 Strands 默认配置与内置工具
items.brief: AgentCore harness 改用开源 Strands 框架，提供推荐模型、任务默认配置、自动提示缓存、上下文管理和生命周期钩子。
items.why: 企业搭智能体可少写底层代码，权限校验更可控，落地门槛降低。

items.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
items.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. items.zh: 英伟达与微软扩大合作，从 Azure 延伸至 Windows PC

items.title: Can You Undo It? Reversibility Classes for AI Agent Actions
items.summary: arXiv:2611.22075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using AI agents change files, databases, access rights and public information, yet permission to call a tool does not establish whether a mistake can be undone. We present Reversibility Classes, a declared five-level vocabulary with argument-sensitive rules, conservative defaults and an explicit prior-state capture contract. The pinned implementation and evidence-linked registry cover 536 tools across 20 MCP servers. All 738 rule-case checks conform to declared expectations, while native annotation mapping differs from draft registry labels

items.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
items.summary: GS Caltex connects Amazon SageMaker Canvas to Amazon SageMaker Pipelines so process engineers' no-code models run in production. This post shows how ML engineers reuse validated preprocessing flows and models, cutting deployment from about a week to a few hours and running batch inference every 30 minutes.
items.zh: GS Caltex用SageMaker Canvas落地生产MLOps
items.brief: GS Caltex将SageMaker Canvas接入SageMaker Pipelines，让工艺工程师的无代码模型进入生产，部署时间从约一周缩短到几小时。
items.why: 示范无代码AI如何让业务人员自建模型并快速上线，适合讲AI落地路径。

items.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
items.summary: Coding agents work in tasks, and the number that matters is cost per solved task, not price per token. In this post, you use the AWS CDK to deploy LiteLLM with the NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon Bedrock, then measure cost per solved task for a routed model group against single-model baselines.
items.zh: Bedrock上用NeMo Switchyard路由编码代理请求
items.brief: 介绍用AWS CDK在Amazon Bedrock部署LiteLLM与NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard路由插件，按每个已解决任务成本评估模型路由。
items.why: 提示企业AI成本应按任务结果而非token计价，影响AI预算评估思路。

items.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime V2 snapshots your initialized environment and restores it for each new session, so session start no longer grows with image size. This post explains how V2 starts a session, how to measure session start time, and four patterns to keep work off the first request.
items.zh: AgentCore运行时快速会话启动架构模式
items.brief: 介绍Bedrock AgentCore运行时V2通过快照恢复初始化环境，使会话启动时间不再随镜像大小增长，并给出四种架构模式。

items.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
items.summary: Deploy OpenFold3-preview from Amazon SageMaker JumpStart to predict 3D structures of proteins, DNA, RNA, and ligand complexes in your own AWS account. The post covers asynchronous inference, multi-GPU parallelism, bringing your own MSAs for accuracy and privacy, and scaling to zero to reduce cost.
items.zh: SageMaker JumpStart上线OpenFold3预览版
items.brief: 可在自有AWS账户从SageMaker JumpStart部署OpenFold3-preview，预测蛋白质、DNA、RNA及配体复合物的三维结构。

items.title: Cost-optimizing AssemblyAI speech-to-text inference on AWS with Amazon EC2 Spot
items.summary: Learn how AssemblyAI runs cost-optimized speech-to-text inference at scale on AWS, using Amazon ECS, Amazon EC2 Spot GPU instances, and an Amazon SQS-based retry architecture to achieve 70% cost savings while maintaining SLA commitments across European Regions.
items.zh: AssemblyAI用EC2 Spot降低语音转写成本
items.brief: AWS博客介绍AssemblyAI用ECS、Spot GPU实例和SQS重试架构，在欧洲区域实现70%成本节省并维持SLA。
items.why: 示范AI推理降本70%的工程路径，可作企业算力成本优化案例。

items.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock provides built-in, zero-instrumentation cost attribution that traces every inference call back to the IAM principal that made it. This post shows how to attribute per-user Bedrock costs for AI developer and productivity tools using IAM Identity Center, session tags, and CUR 2.0, and how to enforce per-user usage limits.
items.zh: Bedrock推出零埋点AI成本归因方案
items.brief: AWS介绍Bedrock内置成本归因，可将每次推理调用追溯到发起调用的IAM主体，并按用户分摊费用。
items.why: 解决企业AI工具按人分摊成本难题，适合讲AI投入产出管理。

items.title: Build a model improvement flywheel with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Data Capture
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Data Capture records live inference inputs and outputs to Amazon S3. This post walks through one end-to-end example: capturing a support router's production traffic, surfacing a new-product blind spot with Amazon Athena, fine-tuning on the captured data with the HyperPod training operator, and measuring the before-and-after lift.
items.zh: 用SageMaker HyperPod数据捕获建改进闭环
items.brief: AWS介绍HyperPod Data Capture将线上推理输入输出存入S3，并以客服路由为例做盲点发现与微调。
items.why: 给出模型持续迭代闭环的落地范式，适合讲AI运营机制。

items.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
items.zh: 用SimReady资产搭建机器人抓取仿真
items.brief: Hugging Face发布教程，介绍如何用SimReady资产构建机器人抓取放置仿真。

items.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
items.zh: XYBench：关注问题背后的问题
items.brief: Hugging Face发布XYBench相关文章，讨论问题背后的问题。

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.
items.zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT钱包
items.brief: OpenAI发布ChatGPT Wallet，让ChatGPT Work、Codex等中的智能体在用户批准下完成购买并沿用现有卡片保护。
items.why: AI智能体开始能直接下单付款，企业需关注支付授权与风控。

items.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
items.zh: llama.cpp发布v1.0.0版本
items.brief: Hugging Face发布llama.cpp v1.0.0，称其为本地AI生态提供更强基础。
items.why: 本地部署工具进入1.0，私有化AI方案成熟度提升。

items.title: How AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner
items.summary: From pediatric research to smart hospitals, AI is helping care teams spend less time on routine tasks and more time with patients. Health systems and startups are putting it to work across healthcare, from matching patients to clinical trials to supporting radiologists, hospital teams and patients at home. Clinicians stay at the center, reviewing AI […]
items.zh: 英伟达：AI帮医疗团队更快匹配正确诊疗
items.brief: NVIDIA介绍AI在儿科研究、智慧医院、临床试验匹配和放射科支持等场景中减少常规事务耗时。
items.why: 医疗AI落地案例，可类比讲行业AI提效路径。

items.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
items.summary: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.
items.zh: Shield用OpenAI代理协助技术人员交接旧系统
items.brief: Shield利用OpenAI让Forge代理在旧门户系统中操作，帮助IT技术人员交接工作，专注需要判断的问题。
items.why: 展示AI代理接手重复性系统操作的落地案例，可作企业流程自动化参考。

items.title: Building strong safety evaluations
items.summary: Recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations, based on our own experiences.
items.zh: Anthropic分享构建强安全评估的建议
items.brief: Anthropic工程博客基于自身经验，给出设计、运行和报告安全评估的建议。
items.why: 企业选型AI模型时可参考其安全评估方法。

items.title: Deploy frontier AI models on AWS Trainium with SGLang-Neuron
items.summary: SGLang-Neuron is now publicly available through an AWS Deep Learning Container. With SGLang-Neuron, you can serve models and generate reinforcement learning rollouts with SGLang on AWS Trainium using the same SGLang interface you already know, all running on native PyTorch.
items.zh: AWS Trainium 上线 SGLang-Neuron 容器
items.brief: AWS 通过深度学习容器公开发布 SGLang-Neuron，可在 Trainium 上用熟悉的 SGLang 接口部署模型并生成强化学习 rollout，运行于原生 PyTorch。

items.title: How Natera designed an agentic AI system for lab ops with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Natera built SWARM, an agentic AI system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that captures institutional lab-operations knowledge and deploys it at scale. This post walks through the full architecture, from knowledge base construction to deployment and evaluation, delivering about 130x faster first response and 96.2% automated coverage across support tickets.
items.zh: Natera 用 Bedrock AgentCore 搭建实验室智能体
items.brief: Natera 基于 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 构建 SWARM 智能体系统，沉淀实验室运营知识并规模化部署，首次响应速度提升约 130 倍。
items.why: 可作为企业用智能体沉淀内部经验、提效的落地案例参考。

items.title: Four Amazon Bedrock inference choices that affect cost
items.summary: Your Amazon Bedrock inference bill can keep climbing even after you tune prompts and application logic. Four request-level choices (cache duration, service tier, reasoning effort, and maxTokens) change how many tokens the service processes and the rate applied. We show how we tested each and how to verify the effect.
items.zh: 影响 Bedrock 推理成本的四个选择
items.brief: AWS 分析缓存时长、服务层级、推理强度和 maxTokens 四项请求级选择如何影响 Bedrock 处理的 token 数量与计费费率，并给出测试方法。
items.why: 帮企业控制大模型调用成本，可直接用于给老板讲降本。

items.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
items.summary: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.
items.zh: Amplitude 用 OpenAI 1-2 天交付产品改进
items.brief: Amplitude 基于 OpenAI 模型构建主动式产品智能体 Wave，可识别该做什么、协助团队用编码智能体交付改动并衡量影响。
items.why: 展示 AI 智能体嵌入产品研发流程的提效案例。

items.title: Tokenomics at scale: Track and cap Amazon Bedrock spend per IAM principal with CUR 2.0 and AWS Budgets
items.summary: Get per-identity Amazon Bedrock cost visibility and enforceable spend limits using only AWS-native features, with no application code for the common case. Attribute spend with IAM principal tags, report with CUR 2.0 or Cost Explorer, and enforce with AWS Budgets actions that apply a Deny policy when a threshold is crossed.
items.zh: 按IAM身份追踪并限制Bedrock花费
items.brief: AWS介绍用CUR 2.0和Budgets按IAM主体追踪并强制限制Bedrock支出，无需应用代码。
items.why: 帮企业把AI调用成本按人/部门算清并设上限，控预算。

items.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
items.zh: LLMON：LLM原生标记语言进入Granite 4.1
items.brief: Hugging Face发布LLMON，一种LLM原生标记语言，已用于Granite 4.1 3B和8B模型。

items.title: Optimizing cost per task and proving agent ROI on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Comparing per-token prices hides the real cost of running a model on Amazon Bedrock. This post shows how to calculate the true cost per task across four hidden cost drivers, reduce it with caching, routing, and output constraints, and prove agent ROI with human baselines, holdout experiments, and a five-dimension scorecard.
items.zh: 计算Bedrock单任务成本与Agent ROI
items.brief: AWS介绍如何计算Bedrock真实单任务成本，用缓存、路由和输出约束降本并验证Agent ROI。
items.why: 给老板算清AI Agent投入产出，是落地决策关键。

items.title: Building a self-service LLM gateway with Amazon Bedrock and LiteLLM
items.summary: Build a self-service LLM gateway with LiteLLM on AWS Fargate that puts Amazon Bedrock foundation models behind an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers get instant access through a single API key, while platform teams gain per-user cost controls, quota isolation, and observability.
items.zh: 用Bedrock和LiteLLM搭自助LLM网关
items.brief: AWS介绍在Fargate上用LiteLLM搭建自助LLM网关，统一API密钥、按用户控成本和配额隔离。
items.why: 企业统一管理多模型访问与成本，适合IT治理参考。

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.zh: Google DeepMind发布Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.brief: Google DeepMind宣布推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen。
items.why: 新模型发布，影响企业模型选型与能力评估。

items.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary: Rotating carousel of cards with text "Gemini 4 Hydrogen" "Now in Google Search" and examples from the Google Search UI
items.zh: Google搜索接入Gemini 4 Hydrogen升级
items.brief: Google搜索获重大升级，接入Gemini 4 Hydrogen，界面以卡片轮播展示。
items.why: 搜索入口AI化，影响企业获客与内容曝光方式。

items.title: Run agents securely and efficiently with the next generation AgentCore runtime
items.summary: AI agents now run multi-step workloads for hours and act on behalf of users, raising the bar for secure, scalable agent compute. Learn how the next generation of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime delivers hardware-isolated sessions with faster starts, more compute, usage-based billing, and isolation that now extends to your data.
items.zh: 新一代AgentCore运行时安全高效跑Agent
items.brief: AWS发布新一代Bedrock AgentCore运行时，提供硬件隔离会话、更快启动和按用量计费。
items.why: Agent长时间运行更安全可控，降低企业部署门槛。

items.title: Migrate to Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base with your coding agent
items.summary: The migration guide in the amazon-bedrock skill helps you migrate a customer-managed Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to a Managed Knowledge Base. Your coding agent plans the move with read-only discovery, creates the new knowledge base or an infrastructure-as-code template alongside the original, and validates retrieval before you cut over.
items.zh: 用编码Agent迁移到托管知识库
items.brief: AWS发布迁移指南，用编码Agent将自管Bedrock知识库迁移到托管知识库。
items.why: 降低企业知识库运维负担，迁移成本更可控。

items.title: Build composable, interoperable multi-agent systems with A2A on AWS
items.summary: Build a composable, interoperable multi-agent system on AWS with the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. A LangChain orchestrator on Amazon ECS communicates with a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore across organizational boundaries, using bidirectional, OAuth-authenticated calls, with neither side depending on the other's framework or SDK.
items.zh: 用A2A在AWS构建可互操作多Agent系统
items.brief: AWS演示用A2A协议跨组织连接LangChain编排器与Strands Agent，OAuth认证双向调用。
items.why: 多Agent跨系统协作，适合复杂业务流程自动化。

items.title: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools
items.summary: Learn how to expose an Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base to AI agents as MCP tools through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway while keeping per-user access control. A request interceptor injects verified identity, Policy in AgentCore validates it independently, and a resource-based policy restricts direct access to the knowledge base.
items.zh: 托管知识库工具的细粒度访问控制
items.brief: AWS介绍通过AgentCore Gateway将托管知识库作为MCP工具暴露给Agent，并保留按用户访问控制。
items.why: 解决企业AI数据权限合规，老板关心的安全底线。

items.title: From prototype to production: Engineering agents with Agent DLC
items.summary: Agents stall between demo and release when teams lack a repeatable way to measure how good an agent is and whether the last change helped. This post covers three agent properties that break traditional CI/CD, a measured case where an aggregate metric hides a coverage gap, and Agent DLC: one lifecycle, two loops, and one explicit standard for judging every change.
items.zh: 从原型到生产：用Agent DLC工程化Agent
items.brief: AWS介绍Agent从演示到上线的生命周期方法，含三个破坏传统CI/CD的属性和度量案例。
items.why: 给企业一套Agent质量评估与上线流程参考。

items.title: A New Dawn in the Cloud: ‘Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV’ Is Coming to GeForce NOW
items.summary: Rally the ranks this GFN Thursday. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to GeForce NOW, allowing players to experience the battle for Kronus through cloud gaming. There’s more on the horizon, with NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology coming to War Thunder and Where Winds Meet. Meanwhile, Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen brings new tales […]

items.summary: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.

items.why: 可作为中小企业用 AI 工具提升人效、拉动增长的案例。

items.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
items.summary: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.
items.zh: Holiday Extras 用 Codex 重构应用开发
items.brief: OpenAI 发文介绍 Holiday Extras 使用 Codex 将客户专业知识转化为应用，提升预订转化率。
items.why: 案例说明AI编程工具可直接拉动业务转化，可作老板落地参考。

items.title: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI
items.summary: Learn how Java developers can build production-ready autonomous AI agents using Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI. This post walks through tool calling, conversation memory, resilience patterns, and multi-agent orchestration, then deploys the agent to AWS with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
items.zh: 用 Amazon Bedrock 与 Spring AI 构建自主智能体
items.brief: AWS 博客讲解 Java 开发者如何用 Bedrock 和 Spring AI 构建生产级自主 AI 智能体并部署。
items.why: 偏开发者技术细节，对老板决策价值有限。

items.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
items.summary: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.
items.zh: OpenAI对话律所CEO谈AI重塑法律业务

items.why: 律所是知识密集型行业样板，可类比讲专业服务机构如何用AI重构业务。

items.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
items.summary: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.
items.zh: OpenAI 投入200万美元研究AI与儿童安全
items.brief: OpenAI 承诺投入200万美元支持AI与儿童安全研究，开发衡量风险与机会的共享工具。
items.why: AI合规与安全议题升温，提示企业关注未成年人相关风险。

items.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
items.zh: 3D生成模型微调权威指南
items.brief: Hugging Face发布3D生成模型微调的完整指南，介绍训练方法与流程。

items.title: ChatGPT Ads increases its market presence in 44 countries
items.summary: Aleph selected as ChatGPT Ads’ exclusive reseller in 44 countries to offer local invoicing, in-person support and local market expertise to brands and agencies
items.zh: ChatGPT广告业务扩展至44国
items.brief: Aleph成为ChatGPT Ads在44个国家的独家经销商，为品牌和代理商提供本地开票、线下支持与本地市场经验。
items.why: AI平台广告商业化信号，影响企业营销投放渠道选择。

items.title: OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: A practical guide for enterprises rolling out OpenAI Codex to developers on AWS, with Amazon Bedrock as the model backend, covering the access, governance, and cost decisions that platform, security, and finance teams need to align on.
items.zh: OpenAI Codex 登陆 Amazon Bedrock 企业指南
items.brief: AWS 发布企业指南，介绍在 Bedrock 上部署 OpenAI Codex 的接入、治理与成本决策。
items.why: 多模型选型与治理成本是老板关心的落地决策点。

items.title: Semantic diffing of formal policies with anti-unification
items.summary: A textual diff of two formal policies flags every cosmetic change and hides the one that alters behavior. This post shows how to compute a symbolic, deterministic semantic diff with an open-source anti-unification engine, so reviewers see only the genuine disagreements between two candidate authorization policies.
items.zh: 用反合一实现正式策略的语义差异比对
items.brief: AWS 介绍开源反合一引擎，计算两份正式策略的符号化语义差异，只暴露实质分歧。

items.title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement.
items.zh: SageMaker HyperPod 静默数据损坏检测与恢复
items.brief: AWS 介绍在 PyTorch DDP 中加入三项检查，检测 GPU 静默数据损坏并自动恢复节点。

items.title: Introducing the Web Search API on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Today we're announcing the Web Search API on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: your own code can search the web with a single signed API call, with no gateway and no resources to create. Call it from the AWS SDKs or the AWS CLI and use it in applications, agent loops, and data pipelines.
items.zh: Bedrock AgentCore 推出 Web 搜索 API
items.brief: AWS 发布 AgentCore Web Search API，一次签名调用即可联网搜索，无需网关或创建资源。
items.why: 降低企业智能体联网检索的开发门槛。

items.title: ICYMI: What landed for AI builders in October 2026
items.summary: A recap of the major Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Strands updates from October 2026: new models to match each task, updates that keep agents available and grounded, and clearer cost reporting for AI builders.

items.brief: AWS 回顾 10 月 Bedrock、AgentCore 与 Strands 更新：新模型、智能体可用性与成本报告。
items.why: 可作月度 AI 平台动态素材。

items.title: The attendee’s guide to the AWS re:Invent 2026 AI/ML track
items.summary: AWS re:Invent 2026 includes more than 140 AI/ML track sessions. This attendee's guide helps you find the breakouts, chalk talks, workshops, and builders' sessions that fit your role and goals, spanning AI chips, models and inference, agents, agent trust, and sustainability, so you can build a smarter re:Invent schedule.

items.brief: AWS 介绍 re:Invent 2026 超 140 场 AI/ML 分会，按角色推荐议程。

items.title: Automating AWS Agent Registry updates with push-based architecture
items.summary: This post shows how to keep the AWS Agent Registry current automatically. Using AWS CloudTrail, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and AgentCore Identity, an event-driven pipeline detects MCP server changes and pushes updated tool metadata to the registry with no stored secrets, across single- and multi-account environments.
items.zh: 用推送架构自动更新 AWS Agent 注册表

items.summary: arXiv:2610.37905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework
items.zh: FilingLoop：评估与进化企业披露文件审查智能体
items.brief: 论文构建基准，让LLM智能体审查并修订SEC EDGAR企业披露文件中的隐含缺陷。
items.why: 文档审查类智能体有企业合规落地参考价值。

items.summary: This post presents a five-stage operating model for managing Amazon Bedrock cost: attribute every dollar to an owner, make every request observable, enforce budgets, optimize platform defaults, and operate a review cadence. Written for FinOps and platform engineering teams.
